category_top.rule: F1 single prior: a leave-one-out prior mean shift exceeds that category's interval width
F2 prior collapse: every shrinkage weight above 0.99 (tight) or all below 0.001 (loose)
F3 clustering: median design effect over ranked categories above 2.0
F5 B and C disagree on separability for more than 2 categories
F6 negative control: any separable pair in any permutation
F7 the top-ranked category has fewer category-sessions than the median ranked category
F8 sensitivity movement: a rank change above 2 places among common categories, or a changed separable status, under C5 or C8
